jobs.title: Data & Analytics AI Engineer Tel Aviv-Yafo
jobs.description: Join CHEQ - The Intelligence Standard for the Human-AI Era | Careers Event Don't miss CHEQ at Digital Marketing World Forum from Sept 9 to 10 - Booth 134 Don't miss CHEQ at Digital Marketing World Forum from Sept 9 to 10 - Booth 134 Meet us in New York -------------------------------- All jobs Data & Analytics AI Engineer Tel Aviv All jobs Company Overview CHEQ is the Intelligence Standard for the Human-AI Era, trusted by over 15,000 customers worldwide to confidently engage, transact, and thrive in this new era of digital transformation. Powered by award-winning cybersecurity technology, CHEQ offers the only integrated Traffic, Threat, and Identity Intelligence Engine, enabling companies to distinguish between legitimate users and bad actors - human, AI agent, or bot - and deliver granular, context-specific insights in real-time to marketing, commerce, and security platforms. CHEQ is a global company with offices in Tel-Aviv, New York, London and Tokyo. We are a fast-paced, technology-driven team where everyone's contribution impacts product success. We are looking for a hands-on, business-minded AI Engineer to join our Data & AI Team. This role is for someone who has already built and shipped real AI products in a company environment. You will work as an integral part of the Data & AI Team, partnering directly with business stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities, translate business needs into technical solutions, and build AI products that automate internal processes and create immediate value. The ideal candidate is a builder. You should be comfortable working with LLMs, AI agents, automation workflows, APIs, data pipelines, data warehouses, and internal company systems. You should also be comfortable taking ownership, asking sharp business questions, and moving ideas from concept to production. Our Data Team has already built internal AI products at CHEQ. Now we are looking for someone who can help take us to the next level. What We’re Looking For The right person has built with AI in a real company environment and knows how to turn business needs into practical internal products. They should be comfortable working with stakeholders, understanding how teams operate, and identifying where AI can create meaningful value. Because this role sits inside the Data & AI Team, they also need to be strong with data. That means working confidently with company data, data warehouses, pipelines, APIs, and the technical building blocks that make AI products reliable and useful. This role is for someone hands-on, curious, and hungry to build. Someone who can combine AI, data, and business context to help CHEQ move faster, automate smarter, and turn ideas into measurable business wins. What You’ll Do Build end-to-end internal AI products, automations, agents, and workflows that solve real business problems across CHEQ. Work directly with business stakeholders to understand pain points, define requirements, and turn ideas into scalable AI-driven solutions. Design, prototype, test, deploy, and maintain production AI products using LLMs, AI agents, APIs, automation frameworks, and internal company data. Work hands-on with data tools and infrastructure, including Snowflake, ETLs, data pipelines, APIs, AI tools, and internal servers. Identify high-impact manual processes and turn them into automated AI-driven business wins. Evaluate new AI tools, frameworks, and agentic workflows, and apply them where they can improve productivity, decision-making, or business operations. Help shape internal AI development best practices around reliability, usability, security, documentation, maintainability, and production readiness. Requirements 3 + years of hands-on experience in AI Engineering, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Data Science, Analytics Engineering, or a similar technical role. Proven experience demonstrating strong business acumen, ownership, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently with stakeholders and drive projects from idea to production. Proven customer-facing and internal-facing experience, with the ability to effectively collaborate, communicate, and build strong relationships with both customers and cross-functional stakeholders. Proven experience building and deploying AI-powered products, workflows, agents, automations, or business solutions in a real company environment. Strong hands-on experience with LLMs, AI agents, prompt engineering, RAG, workflow automation, APIs, or AI development frameworks. Ability to code and build practical solutions using Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages. Strong data experience, including ETLs, data pipelines, APIs, databases, data warehouses, and Snowflake. Experience working in a SaaS or B2B technology company. Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field - advantage Advantages Experience with agent frameworks, RAG systems, vector databases, orchestration tools, Snowflake, Airflow, Rivery, Gitlab, Claude, OpenAI, or similar tools. Experience working in a cybersecurity or data company. All jobs Apply for this Job

jobs.title: Product Product Manager, ClickCease (PLG) Tel Aviv-Yafo
jobs.description: Join CHEQ - The Intelligence Standard for the Human-AI Era | Careers Event Don't miss CHEQ at Digital Marketing World Forum from Sept 9 to 10 - Booth 134 Don't miss CHEQ at Digital Marketing World Forum from Sept 9 to 10 - Booth 134 Meet us in New York -------------------------------- All jobs Product Product Manager, ClickCease (PLG) Tel Aviv All jobs Company Overview ClickCease is CHEQ's self-serve Digital Acquisition & Marketing Stack Protection platform, protecting SME/SMB sites from invalid traffic across ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta, and more) and user acquisition funnels (forms, tags, and more). As PLG Product Manager, you will own the product end-to-end: roadmap, growth metrics, and the self-serve experience that converts trial users into expanding customers. We're looking for a Product Manager to join our global Product team and take ownership of ClickCease, CHEQ's self-serve PLG platform. Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer and working closely with the division head, you'll play a key role in shaping the product strategy, influencing business priorities, and driving product decisions across the organization. WHAT YOU'LL DO Own and drive the ClickCease product roadmap - from ideation and prioritization through delivery, launch, and iteration. Define and continuously optimize the self-serve funnel: acquisition, conversion, onboarding, retention, and expansion. Represent the voice of the ICP - conduct market research, user interviews, analyze support trends, and synthesize insights into product decisions. Define, monitor, and report on key PLG metrics: activation rate, time-to-value, trial conversion, MRR expansion, churn rate, and NPS. Lead a KPI-based experimentation culture - design A/B tests, analyze results rigorously, and build institutional knowledge from every experiment. Set pricing and packaging strategy for self-serve subscription tiers, in collaboration with GTM, finance, and leadership. Monitor the competitive landscape across click fraud prevention, ad verification, and broader ad-tech to identify opportunities and threats. Requirements 3 - 6 years total product management experience, with a track record of shipping impactful, customer-facing features at a B2B or B2C SaaS company. PLG / Self-serve product experience [Must Have] - 2+ years as PM on a self-serve SaaS product with a PLG motion (freemium, free trial, or usage-based). You have owned activation and retention funnels, not just features. Martech / Ad-tech / Advertising platform knowledge [Must Have] - Deep familiarity with Google Ads and/or Meta Ads: campaign structure, conversion tracking, pixel setup, audience targeting, and the day-to-day workflow of a PPC advertiser. You speak the advertiser's language. Experimentation discipline - Experience designing, running, and correctly interpreting A/B tests. You treat every roadmap decision as a hypothesis waiting to be validated. SMB market empathy - Deep understanding of small and mid-sized business constraints: budget sensitivity, speed of decision-making, and the outsized value of simplicity in a product. Strong analytical skills - Comfortable with product analytics tools (Mixpanel or similar) and SQL basics. You question the data before acting on it. Relevant pricing & packaging experience - You have worked on subscription tier design, trial mechanics, upgrade flows, or usage-based pricing in a self-serve context. NICE TO HAVE Experience in click fraud prevention, invalid traffic detection, or digital ad verification. Background in security-adjacent SaaS - bot detection, traffic quality scoring, or ad verification platforms such as DoubleVerify or IAS. Experience owning products with third-party API integrations - ad platforms, CRMs, analytics tools, and the technical complexity they bring. All jobs Apply for this Job
